flows.title: Change the name on a Google Account
steps: Go to your Google Account and, at the top left, click Personal info.
Next to the current name, click Edit, and update the name.
Click Save. It can take a few days to show across all Google products.

flows.title: Change the profile picture
steps: Go to your Google Account and click Personal info.
Under Basic info, click Profile picture.
Upload a photo from the computer, or choose one of your Google Photos.
Rotate and crop the photo as needed, and click Next.
At the bottom, click Save as profile picture.

flows.title: Download your Google data
steps: Go to the Google Takeout page. The Google products holding your data are already selected.
Uncheck the box beside any product to leave out. For some products, a button like All data included lets you pick only part of the data.
For Delivery method, select Send download link via email, then select Create export.
In the email that arrives, select Download archive. Downloading the data does not delete it from Google.
